name: llm-wiki-server
description: Hosted LLM Wiki on Cloudflare Workers: one Durable Object per wiki, MCP, OAuth, hybrid search.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Owner secret for `/setup`, admin API calls and OAuth approval. Use a long random value, for example the output of `openssl rand -base64 32`. Keep a copy in your password manager.

VECTORIZE.description: Choose **Create new**. Enter `384` for **Dimensions** and choose `cosine` for **Metric**. Hybrid search needs these values.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores OAuth grants for MCP clients that sign in with a browser. Keep **Create new**.

RAW.description: Stores raw source files. Keep **Create new**.
